headline: Aliko Dangote's Fortune Surges on Refinery Investor Interest
summary: Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, saw his net worth surge to $39.4 billion as his $20 billion oil refinery continues to attract investor interest.
why: Aliko Dangote controls major industrial assets across Africa, and his net worth reflects valuations and investor sentiment toward key continental industrial projects.

impacts.name: Dangote Group
impacts.why: Increased investor interest in the refinery project elevates the valuation of associated assets.
